title: Dill & Parsley Mayonnaise
description: Homemade approximation of the HelloFresh/EveryPlate sachet. No published ingredient list could be found, so this is a sensible copycat. One batch replaces one sachet.

steps.text: Stir the herbs and lemon juice through the mayonnaise. Season with a pinch of salt. Use the whole batch wherever the recipe calls for 1 sachet.
